UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user registered in the HealthLink Pharmacy app, storing personal details and administrative flags.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication and login.

phoneNumber.description: The user's phone number, potentially used for OTP-based login and order notifications.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

isAdmin.description: A flag indicating if the user has administrative privileges for the backend panel.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Defines categories for medicines, such as 'Chronic', 'Wellness', or 'Baby Care', for easy browsing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

name.description: The name of the category (e.g., Chronic, Wellness, Baby Care).

description.description: A brief description of the category.

Manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
Manufacturer.description: Stores information about the manufacturers of medicines.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Manufacturer entity.

name.description: The official name of the manufacturer.

country.description: The country where the manufacturer is based.

website.description: The official website of the manufacturer.

Medicine.title: Medicine
Medicine.description: Represents a single medicine product available in the pharmacy, including its details, pricing, and categorization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Medicine entity.

name.description: The commercial name of the medicine.

description.description: A detailed description of the medicine, including uses and benefits.

price.description: The current selling price of the medicine.

saltComposition.description: The active pharmaceutical ingredient(s) or salt composition of the medicine, used for substitute suggestions.

category.description: The category this medicine belongs to.

isGeneric.description: A flag indicating if this medicine is a generic version, used for 'Save More' suggestions.

isTopDeal.description: A flag indicating if this medicine should be featured in the 'Top Deals' slider on the homepage.

imageUrl.description: URL to the image of the medicine product.

mrp.description: The Maximum Retail Price of the medicine, if applicable.

availableQuantity.description: The current quantity of the medicine available in stock.

uses.description: List of clinical uses for the medicine.

packSize.description: The size of the pack (e.g. 'Strip of 15 tablets').

howItWorks.description: Detailed explanation of the pharmacological action.

safetyAdvice.description: Clinical safety warnings for common scenarios.

Address.title: Address
Address.description: Stores a physical address associated with a user, primarily for delivery purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Address entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this address belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Address)

label.description: A user-friendly label for the address (e.g., 'Home', 'Work').

recipientName.description: The name of the person who will receive deliveries at this address.

streetAddress.description: The street address, including house number and street name.

state.description: The state or province of the address.

postalCode.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the address.

isDefault.description: A flag indicating if this is the user's default delivery address.

Prescription.title: Prescription
Prescription.description: Stores details about user-uploaded prescriptions, including image location, status, and analysis notes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Prescription entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who uploaded this prescription. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Prescription)

imageUrl.description: The URL to the uploaded prescription image in Firebase Storage.

uploadDate.description: Timestamp when the prescription was uploaded.

status.description: The current status of the prescription (e.g., 'Pending Review', 'Reviewed', 'Processed', 'Rejected').

aiAnalysisNotes.description: Notes or suggested medication details generated by AI analysis of the prescription image.

pharmacistNotes.description: Notes added by a pharmacist after reviewing the prescription.

associatedOrderId.description: Reference to an Order created based on this prescription, if applicable. (Relationship: Prescription 1:N Order)

Cart.title: Cart
Cart.description: Represents a user's current shopping cart, holding items they intend to purchase.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Cart entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this cart. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Cart)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cart was initially created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the cart was last updated (e.g., item added/removed, quantity changed).

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents a single medicine item within a user's shopping cart.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CartItem entity.

cartId.description: Reference to the Cart this item belongs to. (Relationship: Cart 1:N CartItem)

medicineId.description: Reference to the Medicine product added to the cart. (Relationship: Medicine 1:N CartItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the medicine added to the cart.

priceAtAddition.description: The price of the medicine at the time it was added to the cart, to handle price changes.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a completed purchase by a user, including order details, total amount, and delivery status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who placed the order. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Order)

orderDate.description: Timestamp when the order was placed.

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the order, including all items and any shipping fees.

status.description: The current status of the order (e.g., 'Pending', 'Processing', 'Shipped', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled').

shippingAddressId.description: Reference to the Address selected for this specific order's delivery. (Relationship: Address 1:N Order)

prescriptionId.description: Optional reference to a Prescription associated with this order, if it contains prescription medications. (Relationship: Prescription 1:N Order)

paymentStatus.description: The status of the payment for this order (e.g., 'Paid', 'Pending', 'Failed').

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a single medicine item included within a placed order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OrderItem entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order this item belongs to. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

medicineId.description: Reference to the Medicine product included in the order. (Relationship: Medicine 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the medicine purchased in this order item.

unitPrice.description: The price of a single unit of the medicine at the time the order was placed.

definition.description: Stores individual user profile data. Each document ID is the user's Firebase Authentication UID. Admin roles are managed in a separate collection. The 'isAdmin' field has been removed from this entity as per DBAC principles.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

definition.description: Dedicated collection for managing global administrator roles. The existence of a document at this path signifies that the user (whose UID is the document ID) has administrative privileges. Used for authorization independence (DBAC).

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the administrator.

definition.description: Publicly accessible collection for medicine categories. Read-only for all users, write-access for administrators.

params.name: categoryId
params.description: The unique identifier for the category.

definition.description: Publicly accessible collection for medicine manufacturers. Read-only for all users, write-access for administrators.

params.name: manufacturerId
params.description: The unique identifier for the manufacturer.

definition.description: Publicly accessible collection for all medicine products. Read-only for all users, write-access for administrators. Optimized for public list operations (QAPs).

params.name: medicineId
params.description: The unique identifier for the medicine product.

definition.description: Stores delivery addresses specific to a user. Authorization is path-based: `userId` must match `request.auth.uid` for read/write access, ensuring Authorization Independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns this address.

params.name: addressId
params.description: The unique identifier for the address.

definition.description: Stores user-uploaded prescriptions. Authorization is path-based: `userId` must match `request.auth.uid` for read/write access, ensuring Authorization Independence. Admins can view all prescriptions.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who uploaded this prescription.

params.name: prescriptionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the prescription.

definition.description: Stores the active shopping cart for a specific user. Document ID is the user's UID. Authorization is path-based: `userId` must match `request.auth.uid` for read/write access. This structure ensures a 1:1 relationship between a user and their cart.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns this cart.

definition.description: Stores individual items within a user's shopping cart. Authorization is inherited from the parent `/userCarts/{userId}` path, maintaining Authorization Independence. Includes denormalized 'priceAtAddition' for data integrity.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns the parent cart.

params.name: cartItemId
params.description: The unique identifier for the cart item.

definition.description: Stores completed orders placed by a user. Authorization is path-based: `userId` must match `request.auth.uid` for read/write access. Admins can read all orders, ensuring Authorization Independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who placed this order.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The unique identifier for the order.

definition.description: Stores individual items within a specific order. Authorization is inherited from the parent `/userProfiles/{userId}/orders/{orderId}` path, maintaining Authorization Independence. Includes denormalized 'unitPrice' for data integrity.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns the parent order.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent order.

params.name: orderItemId
params.description: The unique identifier for the order item.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling.
